states.narration: Each pair of parentheses contains the same product, x times y. Count two copies of that whole product, then five more copies.
Add the counts on the left, keeping two before five. The shared product stays on the right, with x still multiplied by y in that order.
Two plus five is seven. There are seven copies of the same product; we have not found the value of x times y.

editorial.title: Count a product as one group
editorial.setup: A repeated group can contain multiplication. Read x times y inside the parentheses as one unit while counting its copies.
editorial.summary: Two copies plus five copies makes seven copies of x times y. The coefficient changes, while both factors and their order inside the group remain unchanged.
